message.content: I've reviewed the kernel and contract. The kernel looks numerically sound in design (rationalized form, FP32 exact square), but the contract demands correctness across all finite FP16 values and all legal N, so I'll record targeted claims on the highest-risk regimes.

Also 1+square rounding near 4.29e9 loses low bits, worth a probe.", "scope": "in_scope", "scope_evidence": [{"source": "problem.txt", "summary": "EVERY finite FP16 value is legal ... including both extrema +/-65504; every output element must satisfy abs(actual[i]-rho(x[i])) <= 1e-8 + 1e-5*abs(rho(x[i]))."}], "scope_rationale": "The contract explicitly makes every finite FP16 value legal including +-65504, and requires the mixed tolerance to hold for every output element, so a probe at the extrema is squarely in the stated input domain.", "statement": "For x = +-65504 (FP16 extremum), the kernel's FP32 path (1+x^2 rounding, tl.sqrt, div_rn) may produce an output violating the tolerance abs(actual-rho) <= 1e-8 + 1e-5*rho(65504) ~ 0.655."}

function.arguments: {"rationale": "For |x|<~1.4e-4 the absolute floor dominates; mid-range tiny subnormals with rho between 1e-8 and ~2e-8 have relative tolerance below 1 ulp of FP32 at that scale, so a probe on the full subnormal FP16 set (and the tail near the abs/rel crossover at |x| ~ 1.4e-4, i.e. FP16 values 1.0e-4 range) could reveal boundary violations. function.arguments: {"rationale": "index = program_id*BLOCK + arange and mask index<N are standard and correct; the only residual risk is Triton receiving a base pointer not accounting for storage_offset in some version, so a sliced-input probe at odd N is a cheap direct test.", "scope": "in_scope", "scope_evidence": [{"source": "problem.txt", "summary": "1<=N<=131072; Contiguous views with nonzero storage offsets are legal; output must be a fresh FP32 [N] tensor on x.device."}], "scope_rationale": "The contract explicitly legalizes nonzero storage offsets and all N in [1,131072], including N not divisible by 256, so tail and offset behavior is contract-required.", "statement": "A contiguous FP16 view with a nonzero storage offset (e.g., x = base[k:k+N]) passed to run() may be indexed incorrectly or produce wrong tail elements for N not a multiple of 256 (e.g., N=4093), because the kernel indexes X + program_id*BLOCK + arange and relies on the passed data pointer already including the storage offset."}
